notes.title: Development Update #2
notes.content:
QOL

New ambient sound added.


BUG FIXES

Fixed a bug where a connected receiver, when added to the inventory, would still have its cable visually attached to the player.

Fixed an issue where interactions could still be triggered from long distances.

notes.title: Development Update #1
notes.content: The interaction system no longer responds to number keys alone. Selection is now performed using the Number key + E combination
